units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 86">Gen. R. s. 86</cite>, beg.; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 105:5">Midr. Till. to Ps. CV, 16</cite>.
<cite ref="Chullin 95a:6">Ḥull. 95ᵃ</cite> <he>מ׳ וטבחי ישראל</he> if there are meat-stands (kept by gentiles) in a place where the butchers are Jews.

<cite ref="Chullin 92b:1">Ib. 92ᵇ</cite> top <he>אין שוקלין בשר המת במ׳</he> they (the gentiles) do not retail carrion in the markets; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 131:2">Sifré Num. 131</cite> <he>בנו להם מקולים</he> they erected markets for them (Var. <he>קְלָעִים</he>), v. <cite ref="S01396"><he>קֶלַע</he> III</cite>.]—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 1:1:20">Y. Ḥag. I, 76ᵇ</cite> top <he>אפי׳ ממְקִילוֹן</he> even if you have to buy your meat in the market (having no sacrifice of your own).
